description: ApoE4 reduced binding of the recycling adaptor sorting nexin 17 (SNX17) to ApoER2 and inhibited ApoER2 recycling, lowering cell-surface ApoER2 (abstract-level; full text not accessible).
quote: we demonstrated that ApoE4 attenuates the binding of sorting nexin 17 (SNX17) to ApoER2 and inhibits the recycling of ApoER2, resulting in decreased cell surface level of ApoER2
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less SNX17-ApoER2 binding -> less ApoER2 recycling -> less surface ApoER2)
system: Cell system not stated in the abstract (neurite-growth readout implies neuronal cells); ApoE4 compared against ApoE3/control as stated by the authors. Full text subscription-only (SAGE/IOS Press; not in PMC or Europe PMC; Unpaywall: not OA), so species, cell type, dose and assay are unverified. Deviation: unknown model system; SNX17-dependent rather than ARF6-related recycling.
human_check: Abstract only. If you have library access, read the full text and fill system, panel, statistics; class may drop if recycling was inferred rather than measured.

description: Carnosic acid increased SNX17 binding to ApoER2 and counteracted the ApoE4-induced reduction in surface ApoER2, consistent with a reversible recycling block (abstract-level).
quote: we found that CA enhances the binding of SNX17 to ApoER2, counteracts the negative effects of ApoE4 on the cell surface level of ApoER2
summary: (APOE4 + carnosic acid -> more SNX17-ApoER2 binding) -> (surface ApoER2 restored)
system: Cell system not stated in the abstract; ApoE4-treated cells with vs without carnosic acid. Full text subscription-only. Deviation: unknown model system; pharmacological rescue, not genotype comparison.
human_check: Abstract only; class 2 because the manipulated variable is SNX17 binding via a drug with other known actions.
